item.tib: ge khod mgon po rnam gsum gyi rdza 'dzab
item.coloph: mgon po rnam gsum rdza 'dzab 'di/ zhang zhung pu rang ri rtser mdzad pa'o/ rim par brgyud nas dbu btsun gyis/ rim par brgyud nas bdag g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyis zhus pa legs so//

item.tib: mgon po rnam gsum gyi rdza 'dzab
item.coloph: ge khod mgon po rnam gsum gyi rdza 'dzab 'di/ zhang zhung pu rong ri rtser bsgrub pa rdzogs so/ dge legs 'dis kyang phan bde 'byung bar shog rgyal mtshan shes rab la gcod pa bdag gis zhus//
